sources_considered.why: The primary release page did not return its text.
Reports Nvidia's GAAP results and the CEO's statement that generative AI demand drove them.

evidence_items.locator: paragraph after Q1 intro ('Nvidia reported a record quarterly revenue')

receipt.public_excerpt: Nvidia's GAAP net income for Q1 FY 2025 was $14.881 billion, up 21% from $12.285 billion in the previous quarter and up a whopping 628% from $2.043 billion in the same quarter a year before.

evidence_items.explanation: Nvidia earned $14.9 billion of GAAP net income in the quarter ending April 2024. Read with e2, this shows a company making a lot of money from generative AI.

evidence_items.locator: section Datacenter, quote from Jensen Huang

receipt.public_excerpt: "Our datacenter growth was fueled by strong and accelerating demand for generative AI training and inference on the Hopper platform," said Jensen Huang

evidence_items.explanation: The company attributes its record data center growth to generative AI demand. That ties the profit in e1 to generative AI.

metric_scope.metric: Data center revenue growth attributed to generative AI

receipt.public_excerpt: Inside of the Azure growth, 7 percentage points were related to AI, up from 6 points of impact in the previous quarter.

evidence_items.explanation: Microsoft said AI services added 7 points to Azure's 31% growth in the quarter ending March 2024. That is AI revenue for a cloud provider.

metric_scope.metric: AI contribution to Azure revenue growth

unresolved_gaps: I did not separately test the stated cause, that firms adopting generative AI gained no extra revenue.
